instruction.text: Wähle die Bilder in der Reihenfolge aus, in der sie besprochen werden.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>In the future, I envision myself as a professional dancer to be seen on all the big stages of the world.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m5_chirp'>I need to learn how to be better at saving money, so I will be able to fulfil my dreams in the future.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m14_chirp'>I am going to study to become a teacher because I want to do better than the teachers I had in school.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10_chirp'>All my friends talk about getting married or buying a house. I just want to follow my passion: singing.</voice>

instruction.text: Wo hörst du diesen Satz? Wähle aus.

atoms.a: If I pass the exams, I will apply for university in July.
atoms.b: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_chirp'>If I pass the exams, I will apply for university in July.</voice>

atoms.a: Colleen doesn't know what she wants to do after school.
atoms.b: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>Colleen doesn't know what she wants to do after school.</voice>

atoms.a: If I were to start a family, I could not imagine doing it in my twenties.
atoms.b: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_chirp'>If I were to start a family, I could not imagine doing it in my twenties.</voice>

atoms.a: My prediction is that Robin will move abroad after school.
atoms.b: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_chirp'>My prediction is that Robin will move abroad after school.</voice>

atoms.a: My number one priority in life is to be fit and healthy.
atoms.b: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10_chirp'>My number one priority in life is to be fit and healthy.</voice>

atoms.a: I am going to be a vet, no matter how hard it will be.
atoms.b: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f8_chirp'>I am going to be a vet, no matter how hard it will be.</voice>

instruction.text: Welches Wort kommt nicht vor? Wähle es aus.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5Us_chirp'>I'm planning to move to another city for university, but I'm a little scared to be all by myself.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1Us_chirp'>Seeing how people lose jobs to AI, I wonder what it will be like for us when we enter the job market.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f11Us_chirp'>My biggest dream is to have a little family and a home in a small suburb.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3Au_chirp'>I have an interview for my dream job next month and I am extremely nervous I might fail it.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6Us_chirp'>Joanna is so good at hockey, I bet she will qualify for the world cup one day.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1Us_chirp'>I took a course on pottery last week and I would love to make it my new hobby if it wasn't so expensive.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f6_chirp'>It is difficult to find the right profession at a young age when so many doors are open for you.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>Social media often gives the impression that we could do anything with our lives, although for most of us that isn't true.</voice>

parentTopic.title: What will happen in the future?
